# OkSaaS

> Discover the best SaaS tools, indie products, and startups. A curated directory to find your next favorite tool.

## About

OkSaaS is a curated directory of SaaS products, indie tools, and startups. Makers submit their products and get listed with a description, logo, and backlink. Users browse, discover, and filter tools by category and recency.

## Features

- **Curated Directory**: Browse hundreds of SaaS products and tools
- **Free Submissions**: Makers can submit their product with a dofollow backlink
- **Promoted & Featured Listings**: Highlighted placement for selected products
- **Filtering**: Filter by time period (last week, last 3 months, last 6 months, all time)
- **SEO-Friendly**: Each listing includes a dofollow backlink to the product

## How It Works

1. Makers submit their SaaS product via the submission form
2. Products are reviewed and added to the directory
3. Each product gets a listing with logo, description, and link
4. Users browse and discover new tools

## Categories

Products span many categories including: AI tools, developer tools, marketing, SEO, design, productivity, finance, video editing, form builders, resume builders, compliance, fitness, education, and more.

## Tech Stack

- Built with Astro (static site generator)
- Hosted on Vercel
- Data-driven listings from a curated JSON dataset
